purpose: Reconcile the six cross-published weapon source-claim pairs into six canonical production identities before the 203-identity Phase 3 canonical weapon authority is built.
mergePolicy: Preserve every certified source claim and its provenance even after claims are reconciled to one production identity.
Phase 1 identity rulings control whether two source claims are one production identity; Phase 3 does not create new duplicates.
Identical certified facts collapse to one canonical fact with multiple provenance sources.
Source-certified mechanics that are additive and nonconflicting are unioned into the canonical identity.
A later source's silence does not delete an earlier certified mechanic unless the later source explicitly contradicts or supersedes it.
Explicit source conflicts are represented as conflict objects and are not silently adjudicated.
Repository values never decide a source conflict.
Phase 3A does not mutate packs, runtime code, schemas, feats, talents, actors, or production records.

additiveMechanics: Preserve the +2 equipment bonus to Use the Force checks for Block and Deflect.
Preserve the lightsaber-resistant defensive interaction already certified for the weapon object.
Preserve the Jedi Academy energy-cell operating requirement.
records.phase3Rule: Build one canonical identity now, but leave the restriction field conflict-marked until precedence is explicitly resolved.

mergedMechanics: Reach increases threatened reach by 1 square.
Block and Deflect Use the Force checks take the certified -2 penalty.
Long Haft Form conditionally turns the weapon into a double weapon.
The Long Haft Form haft-end profile deals 1d6 with source-unspecified damage type and does not inherit lightsaber DR bypass.

records.phase3Rule: Collapse the two compatible claims to one canonical identity while retaining both provenance sources.

rebellionOnlyMechanics: 50-shot power pack explicitly certified in the Rebellion Era entry.
records.phase3Rule: Do not let the current repo values choose the winner. Carry both claim sets until precedence is explicitly adjudicated.

sources.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

canonicalMerge.stunMechanic: Convert the wearer's successful unarmed melee attack to stun damage and add +1 stun damage.

variantData: Preserve KOTOR's certified size/cost/weight variants rather than flattening the identity to one fixed Tiny/200/0.4 line.
Clone Wars confirms the same underlying mechanic and the Human/Tiny example.

mergedMechanics: When wielded two-handed, preserve the choice between doubled Strength on normal base damage or 2d10 base damage without the doubled Strength bonus.
Preserve the Long Haft Form conditional double-weapon profile from Jedi Academy.
The Long Haft Form haft end deals 1d6 with source-unspecified damage type and does not inherit lightsaber DR bypass.

phase3Subphases.output: Merge Phase 1 provenance/player text/summary with Phase 2 v2.9 mechanics into one record per production identity.

phase3Subphases.name: Production Disposition Ledger
phase3Subphases.output: KEEP / UPDATE / CREATE / RENAME / MERGE / REMOVE_UNSUPPORTED / REVIEW_PRECEDENCE disposition for every identity.

phase3Subphases.name: Global Verification and Freeze
phase3Subphases.output: Deterministic 203-identity authority, source-claim traceability back to all 209 claims, no untracked conflicts, and final handoff to tag archaeology.

phase3Acceptance: Exactly 209 certified source claims remain traceable.
Exactly 203 unique production identities are emitted.
Exactly six cross-publication claim pairs collapse to six identities rather than twelve.
No source-certified prose or mechanic is silently discarded.
All unresolved conflicts are explicit machine-readable conflict objects.
Every canonical identity has provenance, canonical player text, summary, v2.9 mechanics, ammo authority, repo mapping, and production disposition or conflict gate.
No production mutation occurs during Phase 3 authority construction.

findingsForPlanner.detail: Force Unleashed certifies "incoming lightsaber does not ignore the weapon DR" unconditionally; Jedi Academy certifies it only when the handle is phrik-laced. The package lists the lightsaber-resistant interaction as additive; the certified claims diverge on its condition.
findingsForPlanner.suggestedHandling: Treat as a second conflict object on Guard Shoto, or rule precedence.

findingsForPlanner.detail: Force Unleashed certifies the same DR resistance unconditionally; Jedi Academy certifies it only for a phrik-alloy haft. The package marks the Pike resolved with no conflicts.
findingsForPlanner.suggestedHandling: Either rule that Jedi Academy narrows/clarifies the condition (then the Pike stays resolved) or carry a conflict object; Claude did not adjudicate.

findingsForPlanner.detail: Both Jedi Academy claims add Long Haft Form; the Force Unleashed Pike and Legacy Era Long-Handle claims carry no haft-end profile (silence, not contradiction), consistent with the merge policy.
